name: Vanilla Celebration Cake
blurb: Soft vanilla sponge, buttercream, your message on top.

details.description: Two soft layers of vanilla sponge with silky buttercream, finished with pink and lemon rosettes. We pipe your message on top.

name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
blurb: Dark chocolate sponge with fudge icing.

details.description: Dark chocolate sponge, fudge icing and a glossy ganache finish. Rich, moist and made for chocolate lovers.
includes: Chocolate curls and fresh raspberry on top

name: Small Chops Box
blurb: Puff-puff, samosa, spring rolls and chicken wings.

details.description: A box of party favourites: puff-puff, samosa, spring rolls and chicken wings, packed hot and ready to share.

name: Agege Bread
blurb: Soft, dense and baked every morning.

details.description: Soft, dense Agege bread, baked every morning. Perfect with eggs, stew or just butter.

name: Meat Pie
blurb: Flaky pastry with minced beef filling.

details.description: Golden flaky pastry filled with seasoned minced beef. Great warm, great for parties.

name: Wedding Cake
blurb: Tiered and designed with you. Tastings by appointment.

details.description: Tiered and designed with you, from flavours to flowers. Message us your date and ideas and we will plan a tasting.
